candidate.source_summary: Encrypted session data from cookies via pickle serialization, with space padding added during encryption
candidate.guard_summary: No padding validation or integrity checking; rstrip() removes all trailing whitespace including padding
candidate.risk_pattern: AES decryption followed by rstrip() removes all trailing whitespace, potentially corrupting decrypted plaintext if original data contained trailing spaces or if padding removal is incorrect
candidate.context_summary: Session cookie decryption path: base64 decode -> AES decrypt -> rstrip() -> pickle deserialize. Encryption pads with spaces to 16-byte blocks, decryption strips all trailing spaces.
unresolved_facts: Whether original session data can contain legitimate trailing spaces that would be corrupted
Whether the AES mode used requires specific padding validation
Whether other crypto implementations (pycryptopp, JCE) handle padding differently
